title: Shameless self-promo: after 26 days, I FINALLY got my AI trading app on the App Store
author: NextgenAITrading
selftext:
I'm so excited about this milestone and I have nobody to share it with so I thought to share it with Reddit :)

After weeks of responding to emails, posting and uploading screenshots, and fixing bugs, I finally got my algorithmic trading platform onto the App Store!

NexusTrade isn't a wrapper around ChatGPT. It allows you to create, backtest, and deploy automated trading strategies. You can go to the marketplace, clone an existing strategy, or create your own. 

Despite being fully no-code, NexusTrade is extremely flexible. You can create strategies based on technical indicators (eg SMA, MACD), fundamental indicators (eg P/E ratio and Market Cap), economic indicators (like CPI or unemployment rate), and even alternative data sources (like sentiment data). You can connect via MCP, use the no-code UI, and now download the app on the App Store!

If you want to try it out, I have a generous free plan, and if you DM me or comment below, I'll give you a 3-month coupon, no question asked. Tear it apart and let me know what you think!
